source_report: Dupire's Local Volatility Model and Its Use on FX Exotic Desks
method: The paper's own derivation, written out line by line with its own equation numbers: the local volatility SDE, forward Kolmogorov, Breeden-Litzenberger, the integration by parts, the zero-rate Dupire formula, then the FX drift and the deterministic-rate FX Dupire formula. Typeset from the paper, not reconstructed.
palette: Dark visual system shared by all five divisions: near-black ground, white primary content, the design system's light purple (#AFA2D2) and a muted pink sibling (#CDA2BF) as accents, grey for structure.
